scope: Execute Event occurrence-data construction from shared source-derived cases with independent complete provider/facade/reference observation. Events are neither Entity factories nor publication/registration commands; explicit clock effects remain the only generated-time effect.
reference: Keep every shared source request and expected outcome, descriptor case, supplied/generated clock condition, repeat, optional absence and invalid carrier. Preserve existing TypeScript case preparation and bounded whole-row not_evaluable capacity. Append Python-native carrier cases, never silently skip a shared case.
carrier_transport: Signed integer strings and BigInt transport to exact Python str/int; shared safe Number integers transport to int, unsafe or fractional Number negatives to float. JS BigInt decimal negatives transport to a distinct integer subclass because Python itself permits exact integer decimal inputs. Additional native int-to-decimal and float-to-integer cases test that distinction, finite conversion and overflow. Decimal views compare numeric values with canonical positive zero. No new coercion or normalization behavior is added.
shape_and_clock: Inert frozen/null-prototype JS dictionaries transport as exact Python dicts; hostile subclass inputs cover accessor/inheritance/non-enumerable rejection without reading them. Generated missing/undefined/null clocks transport as non-callables, while Python missing-argument TypeError is checked separately. Supplied-time Events receive no clock argument. Count clock calls, preserve exact raised-clock identity, and reject async-like results without awaiting them.
native_checks: Check frozen nominal Event records, immutable/detached occurrence and payload mappings, fresh repeated outputs, exact scalar types, complete descriptor/source identity, shared NewType reference identity, immutable bindings and no input mutation or coercion. Reuse the existing independent whole-module observer with in-memory mutation inputs and Unicode metadata digest compatibility; reject two compiling value/effect substitutions per Event.
integration: Retain one bounded workspace/process pipeline, private metadata without copied child artifacts, source/interpreter/toolchain/workspace/cleanup invalidation, all97 predecessor source assets and existing generated bytes. All other missing metatypes and formal/cross-generator obligations remain explicit.
claim_ceiling: Bounded source-directed native Event evidence, not universal proof, arbitrary Python sandboxing, occurrence uniqueness, persistence, publication, external registration, profile activation or full CLI readiness.
